prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion", "Select a pet archetype or craft a custom friend to join you on your desktop."]
1: ["Sign In to Sync Your Desktop Pet", "Log in with your existing account to access saved pets and keep progress synced.", "Use your primary registration email to prevent creating duplicate empty accounts."]
2: ["Preparing Your Desktop Workspace", "We are generating your pet assets and verifying desktop window display permissions."]
3: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Your pet is ready on screen. Manage pet visibility and desktop controls directly from your tray menu."]
4: ["Find Your Ideal Onboarding Path", "Select quick adoption for instant setup, or custom creation to build a pet from photos."]
5: ["Use bright, clear photos with full head visibility to avoid pet render distortion."]
6: ["Creating Your Companion", "Generating pet animations. We will notify you as soon as your companion appears on desktop."]
7: ["Your Pet is Live!", "Swipe through the guide to learn how to drag, interact, or minimize your desktop pet.", "Finish Setup"]
8: ["Select Your Pet Creation Journey", "All paths include free desktop themes and starter pet items.", "Includes Free Starter Item Bundle"]
9: ["Quick Account Sign-In", "Sign in to save your pet companion state securely.", "Sign In & Continue"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free extras and starter bundles
